name: Tanigawa Megumi
source:
The protagonist's co-worker, a detective story fan and future idol singer

"You and Megumi lost a bag your employer asked you to go and get so you had to go and find it. Being the detective story fan she is, Megumi used the opportunity to cosplay as Sherlock Holmes!"
